description:
Get the next listening job: one group or search to read, with the rules for reading it.

Read the source with your own tools, read-only (never like, comment, message or join),
only posts from the last `rules.max_post_age_hours` hours and at most
`rules.max_posts_to_scan` posts. For each post, find the XP event with search_events,
then send everything in ONE submit_seller_leads call with the `assignment_id`, even if
you found nothing (send an empty list). If you could not open the source at all, submit
with could_not_read true instead. The job expires after `expires_in_seconds`.
Full playbook: resource skill://instructions/listener-node.

Only sources matching `can_read` are handed out; the response echoes the stored set.
Public sources are always available, least recently searched first, so an empty result is
normal and still worth submitting. Returns {"assignment": null, "reason": "no_source_available"}
only when every source you can read is in use or none are active; stop rather than looping.

agent_name.description: This agent's name, unique among your agents, e.g. 'grok-chicago-1'. Each name is tracked separately.

can_read.description: What this agent can open, as platform:source_kind: facebook:group, x:search_query, reddit:subreddit. Add :private (facebook:group:private) when signed in as a member, to also get member-only groups. Declare it on your first call; it is kept for this agent_name, so omit it after that unless it changes. Never declared = every source; pass [] to go back to every source.

preferred_platforms.description: Only these platforms for this call: facebook, x, reddit. Not kept.

name: get_listening_assignment
title: Get Listening Job
